svg.title: Track record
svg.desc: Track record. Hack The Box Cyber Apocalypse CTF 2026: 30th of 6,744 teams, the top 0.5%, with all 136 flags and 69,425 points, as Team Mythos Larpers; drawn as a field of 6,744 dots, one per team in finishing order, the top 30 lit and the 30th marked. Singapore Cyber Conquest 2026: Student Finalist; top 20 student teams online (CSA and TrendAI), onsite finals at Singapore International Cyber Week on 14 Oct. DSTA BrainHack 2026, CDDC: Finalist, Explorer category; qualifier in May, two-day final in June.
